changelog:
alibabacloud-pts-pilot 0.0.1 — Initial Release

- Introduces a router-only skill for Alibaba Cloud PTS (Performance Testing Service) operations.
- Parses user intent, matches to the appropriate sub-skill, and delegates execution; does not perform any CLI/API actions itself.
- Supports three sub-skills: alibabacloud-pts-task (CRUD operations), alibabacloud-pts-reporter (report analysis), and alibabacloud-find-skills (skill discovery).
- Complies with Qoder loader requirements with dedicated SKILL.md at the ZIP root and sub-skills as peer directories.
- Clearly documents trigger phrases, delegation rules, and input/output contracts for each sub-skill.
